arms.better: The first attempt repeatedly reread the same ignore and walker code, exhausted 64 steps, and only surfaced `Run tm run T-1 again to retry`; the second attempt repeated broad exploration and was manually stopped at its 600-second share of the 1200-second cap without submitting or reporting a final result. Reduce repeated file context, expose progress and remaining step/time budget, and make retry resume the existing investigation or give a clear continuation summary. The event stream recorded about 10.9 million tokens across 96 usage events. Verification pass is only mechanical: PR #3420 changed one file (`crates/ignore/src/dir.rs`) containing both implementation and regression test, so the required checkout of that file overwrote the agent's implementation with the fix before `cargo test -p ignore`; it cannot establish that tm's implementation passed the hidden regression test.

The initial semantic index lookup was unavailable and one guessed source path was wrong; the agent recovered using exact search and relevant crate files, implemented the cache-key change, added a multiple-root regression test, and ran the crate suite successfully. It could be more efficient by falling back immediately from unavailable semantic search and by focusing the initial investigation on `crates/ignore/src/dir.rs` and the walker tests. Mechanical hidden-test verification also has the same PR-file limitation: the checked-out file contains implementation and tests together, so the post-run checkout supplied the fix itself.
